data.summary: The macros directory contains reusable SQL macros for the data transformation pipeline, focusing on time zone handling and conversions.

file_insights.name: time.sql
file_insights.summary: SQL macro file providing time zone and UTC conversion rules for data pipelines.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains SQL/Jinja macro definitions for date and time rules, specifically implementing utc_date and related time conversion functions.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines SQL macros for standardizing time zone handling across the project, ensuring all stored times are instants (timestamptz) and handling conversions between UTC and session local time.
responsibilities: Define UTC date and time manipulation macros
